name: native-restore-memory
goal: Bound evidence restoration memory while preserving note selection and missing evidence checks

evidence: The hosted macOS verifier exhausted its reserve. On restored real history, existing restore, trust and impact retained 2.48 GB RSS; a batched verification-note and streamed-record prototype retained 1.40 GB and selected the same records.

test/repositories/explanation-notes-order.test.ts uses only two small note-bearing commits and does not exercise restoration with many large notes or corrupt entries. Extend that existing note fixture with realistic large Git notes, a cached verification and missing or mismatched evidence.
